Assumptions / Conditions / Definitions.
- Consider the limiting configuration invoked for the optimal paper Moebius band.

Statement:
The absolute theoretical limit of the optimal paper Moebius band is a sequence of $6$ equilateral triangles folded flat into a single doubly-covered equilateral triangle of side length $2/\sqrt{3}$. This limit configuration has altitude $1$ and perimeter $2\sqrt{3}$. It self-intersects.
fixed_proof:
This is the limiting configuration described in the source: six equilateral triangles fold flat into a doubly-covered equilateral triangle, whose altitude is $1$ and whose perimeter is $2\sqrt{3}$.

The perimeter is
\[
3\cdot\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}=2\sqrt{3}.
\]
Being flat, it self-intersects.
